frozen_before: any scored producer execution of this case; the original five-episode discrepancy, the reduced cache probe and this lane's population identification are already exposed

role.current_population_summary: the statistics summarize exactly the declared current directory population under the declared transform and convention
role.parent_population_summary: the statistics summarize a declared superset population enumerated by retained evidence (here meta/episodes_stats.jsonl) of which the current directory is a subset
role.external_reference_normalizer: the statistics are a separately selected reference whose population is not the current directory

facts_kept_separate: numeric agreement (published vs recomputed under stated tolerances)
population identity (which rows the published values summarize)
provenance (who/what produced the file, from history)
interpretation (the normalization formula that consumes the values)
selection (which caller/invocation binds the file to an execution)
software applicability (whether reuse/recompute/abstain is justified for the scoped invocation)

reference_algorithm.reader: nisayon.evaluation.parquet_reader (pure Python, identity recorded per run); shared with no decision function
reference_algorithm.membership: every declared episode file present, rows equal declared length, frame_index 0..n-1, episode_index constant, global index continuous, timestamps at 1/fps, coordinate count equal to the declared shape; a violation is invalid, not unresolved
reference_algorithm.exact: per coordinate: mu = fsum(x)/n; variance = fsum((x-mu)^2)/n (population, ddof 0); std = sqrt(variance); min, max; q01 and q99 by the numpy linear rule pos = q*(n-1), interpolate between floor and ceil; all in float64 over the exact float32 values
reference_algorithm.float32_convention: numpy float32 reduction along axis 0 of the stacked (N, D) array, as the pinned calculate_dataset_statistics does; reported beside the exact values
reference_algorithm.pooling_from_per_episode_statistics: mean = sum(n_i m_i)/N; variance = sum(n_i (s_i^2 + m_i^2))/N - mean^2; min = min_i min_i; max = max_i max_i; quantiles not reproducible from per-episode statistics
reference_algorithm.non_finite: any NaN or infinity in a compared column makes the column invalid; never dropped

T1_direct_recomputation.applies: published vector against recomputation from the complete declared population (raw rows)
T1_direct_recomputation.justification: float32 reduction error over the subset is at most 5.2e-6 relative (measured); the declared upstream test tolerance is the same order

T2_extremes.rule: exact equality of float32 values; extremes involve no arithmetic

T3_pooled_from_float32_episode_statistic.applies: published moments against pooling of float32-rounded per-episode statistics over about 1e5 rows
T3_pooled_from_float32_episode_statistic.justification: numpy's sequential float32 axis-0 reduction over 101,469 rows accumulates about 3e-4 relative std error (demonstrated on a synthetic binary column of the same length and mean: 3.2e-4; pairwise 3.8e-8; subset 5.2e-6); means of dyadic values stay exact
T3_pooled_from_float32_episode_statistic.identity_rests_on: T2 exact equality on every coordinate plus bit-identical per-episode entries for the retained files, not on T3

tolerance_policy.quantiles: compared only when raw rows of the claimed population are retained; otherwise reported as bracketed-consistent or not comparable, never as matched

original_public_input.input: the five retained Parquet files, meta/info.json, meta/stats.json (sha256 8283e003…), meta/episodes_stats.jsonl (sha256 884f963e…) at 1a1837f2
original_public_input.population_binding: supported: 379 episodes / 101,469 frames enumerated; extremes exact on 15/15; per-episode entries bit-identical for the five files
original_public_input.arithmetic: supported for the parent within T2/T3; rejected as a summary of the five-episode directory (T1 fails on every vector; extremes strictly outside the subset)
original_public_input.provenance: supported from history: unchanged since release 23ace64f; fingerprints attached at 4c0662fc without recomputation
original_public_input.interpretation: unresolved pending the execution lane's call-path evidence for the consuming normalizer formula
original_public_input.selection: supported for the scoped software invocation check_stats_validity/generate_stats on the demo directory (the pinned tests assert acceptance and reuse); unresolved for inference-time precedence between a checkpoint's statistics and the dataset file
original_public_input.expected_decision: supported for reuse of the identified parent-population reference in the scoped invocation; recompute is not a justified correction because it would replace the parent normalizer with a five-episode summary; the author's intent for the demo subset stays unresolved and is named as the missing evidence
original_public_input.exposure: these expectations were written after this lane's own identification; they are frozen before the producer's scored execution only

PBC02-current-population-mismatch.arithmetic: rejected (T1 fails after a content change with the declaration unchanged)

PBC03-bound-external-reference.role: parent_population_summary or external_reference_normalizer with an enumeration that reproduces the extremes (T2) and moments (T3)
PBC03-bound-external-reference.decision: supported, with subset mismatch not a rejection premise; no deployment or training-lineage claim

PBC04-missing-role-or-selection.decision: unresolved with the exact missing evidence named

PBC05-unchanged-label-changed-content.rule: the decision must equal what the content alone gives; a role string of 'training_reference' or 'current' changes nothing

PBC06-empty-invalid-nonfinite.decision: invalid, with distinct reasons: empty population, non-finite value, wrong coordinate count, malformed file

failure_states.invalid: malformed file, empty population, non-finite value, dimension mismatch, undeclared feature; a process failure is reported as failed, not as any decision
failure_states.unresolved: a well-formed record whose role, membership, interpretation or selection evidence is missing; the missing item is named

conventional_diagnostic.owner: this lane, separate module from the reference
requirements: inspects the declared role and the retained evidence
recomputes from raw rows when the obligation is a current summary
pools a retained per-episode enumeration when one exists and identifies the population from the extremes
returns unresolved when role or selection evidence is absent
imports no execution verdict function and no reference expectation
decisions follow content, not candidate names or labels
conventional_diagnostic.qualification: the frozen controls above; qualification is not a Nisayon gain

stopping_rule: Assess one original-input execution and the frozen controls once; a tie between the conventional diagnostic and the Nisayon path is retained; no other dataset, model, simulator, robot or reserved incident.
